title: The loop is sense, act, observe, stop.

steps.name: Sense
steps.detail: Read only the state needed for the next decision.

steps.name: Think
steps.detail: Choose one action and name the expected result.

steps.name: Act
steps.detail: Call one permitted tool with bounded arguments.

steps.name: Observe
steps.detail: Compare the tool result to the goal, not to fluency.
